jobs.title: Senior Deviation Specialist
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
Currently we are looking for Senior Deviation Specialist who will own Major and Minor deviations and ensure they are completed with the expected level of Quality and accuracy and within the expected timelines.

Key responsibilities:

• Own, investigate, author, and record assigned Deviations.

• Liaise with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and key stakeholders to establish the root cause(s) of deviations and the potential impact of said deviations.

• Ensure proper investigation tools are used to systematically define all root causes and contributing factors (e.g. Logic Fault Tree, Defense analysis, Event & Causal Factors chart, Fishbone)

• Define and agree with SMEs appropriate CAPA(s), and associated Effectiveness Checks.

• Ensure cGMP compliance and consistency through the investigation process and drive their quality records to completion and closure according to scheduled release times.

• Support the business through ongoing change and process improvement activities.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Key requirements:

• Bachelor degree/ Diploma in a Chemistry/Biotechnology/Life sciences or related discipline

• Ability to plot and read data, statistics basic knowledge is a nice to have

• Understanding and application of Human & Organizational Performance principles

• RCA training

• Analytical thinking and problem solving skills

• High adaptability in dynamic work environments

• Effective and efficient time management

• Skillful knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Project, PowerPoint)

• Fluency in English

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.
Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di Senior Deviation Specialist che possederà deviazioni principali e minori e garantire che siano completati con il livello previsto di qualità e precisione e entro i termini previsti.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Possedere, indagare, autore e registrare assegnato Deviazioni.

• Liaise with Oggetto Matter Experts (PMI) e le principali parti interessate per stabilire la causa principale delle deviazioni e l'impatto potenziale di tali deviazioni.

• Assicurare strumenti di indagine appropriati sono utilizzati per definire sistematicamente tutte le cause della radice e fattori che contribuiscono (ad esempio Logic Fault Tree, analisi della difesa, grafico Event & Causel Factors, Fishbone)

• Definire e concordare con le PMI appropriate CAPA(s), e controlli di efficacia associati.

• Assicurare la conformità e la coerenza cGMP attraverso il processo di indagine e guidare i loro record di qualità al completamento e alla chiusura secondo i tempi di rilascio programmati.

• Sostenere il business attraverso le attività di cambiamento e miglioramento dei processi in corso.

• Eseguire altri compiti come assegnato.

Requisiti chiave:

• Laurea / Diploma in Chimica / Biotecnologia / Scienze della vita o disciplina relativa

• Capacità di tracciare e leggere i dati, statistiche conoscenza di base è un bello avere

• Comprensione e applicazione dei principi delle prestazioni umane e organizzative

• Formazione RCA

• Analitico pensiero e problem solving competenze

• Alta adattabilità in ambienti di lavoro dinamici

• Gestione efficiente del tempo

• Conoscenza competente di Microsoft Windows e Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Project, PowerPoint)

• Fluency in inglese

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.
La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, status veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.
Derzeit suchen wir nach Senior Deviation Specialist, der größere und kleinere Abweichungen besitzt und sicherstellt, dass sie mit dem erwarteten Qualitäts- und Genauigkeitsniveau und innerhalb der erwarteten Zeitpläne abgeschlossen werden.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Besitzen, untersuchen, Autor und Aufzeichnung zugewiesener Abweichungen.

• Kontaktaufnahme mit Fachexperten (KMU) und wichtigen Interessengruppen, um die Ursache(n) von Abweichungen und die möglichen Auswirkungen dieser Abweichungen zu ermitteln.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass geeignete Untersuchungswerkzeuge verwendet werden, um alle Ursachen und beitragenden Faktoren systematisch zu definieren (z. B. Logic Fault Tree, Defense Analysis, Event & Causal Factors Chart, Fishbone).

• Definieren und vereinbaren Sie mit KMU geeignete CAPA(s) und damit verbundene Wirksamkeitsprüfungen.

• Gewährleistung der cGMP-Compliance und -Konsistenz durch den Untersuchungsprozess und Vervollständigung und Schließung der Qualitätsaufzeichnungen gemäß den geplanten Veröffentlichungszeiten.

• Unterstützen Sie das Unternehmen durch laufende Veränderungs- und Prozessverbesserungsaktivitäten.

• Führen Sie andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus.

Hauptanforderungen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss / Diplom in einer Chemie / Biotechnologie / Biowissenschaften oder verwandten Disziplin

• Fähigkeit, Daten zu zeichnen und zu lesen, Statistik Grundwissen ist ein schön zu haben

• Verständnis und Anwendung von Human & Organizational Performance Prinzipien

• RCA-Ausbildung

• Analytisches Denken und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

• Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit in dynamischen Arbeitsumgebungen

• Effektives und effizientes Zeitmanagement

• Geschickte Kenntnisse von Microsoft Windows und Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Project, PowerPoint)

• Fluency in Englisch

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.
Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber erhalten eine Gegenleistung für eine Beschäftigung ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter, Status als qualifizierte Person mit Behinderung, geschützter Veteranenstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale.
Der tatsächliche Standort dieses Jobs ist in Visp, Schweiz. Umzugshilfe ist für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien zur Verfügung, wenn nötig.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur cinq continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.
À l'heure actuelle, nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste principal des écarts qui sera propriétaire des écarts majeurs et mineurs et s'assurera qu'ils sont complétés avec le niveau prévu de qualité et d'exactitude et dans les délais prévus.

Principales responsabilités :

• Déviations assignées, enquête, auteur et enregistrement.

• Assurer la liaison avec les experts en la matière (PME) et les principaux intervenants afin d'établir la ou les causes profondes des écarts et l'impact potentiel de ces écarts.

• S'assurer que des outils d'investigation appropriés sont utilisés pour définir systématiquement toutes les causes profondes et les facteurs contributifs (p. ex. arbre de défaillance logique, analyse de la défense, diagramme des facteurs d'événement et de causalité, Fishbone)

• Définir et accepter avec les PME les CAPA appropriés et les vérifications d'efficacité connexes.

• Assurer la conformité et l'uniformité des BPFc par le biais du processus d'enquête et conduire leurs dossiers de qualité à l'achèvement et à la fermeture selon les délais de libération prévus.

• Appuyer les activités par des activités de changement et d'amélioration des processus.

• Exécuter d'autres fonctions selon l'affectation.

Principales exigences:

• Baccalauréat/diplôme en chimie/biotechnologie/sciences de la vie ou discipline connexe

• Capacité de tracer et de lire des données, statistiques connaissances de base est un agréable à avoir

• Comprendre et appliquer les principes du rendement humain et organisationnel

• Formation RCA

• Capacités de réflexion analytique et de résolution de problèmes

• Haute capacité d'adaptation dans des environnements de travail dynamiques

• Gestion efficace et efficiente du temps

• Connaissance compétente de Microsoft Windows et Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Projet, PowerPoint)

• Connaissance de l ' anglais

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.
Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés pour un emploi sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'identité de genre, à l'âge, au statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, au statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.
L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Viège, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Für unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir einen Anlagen- und Apparatebauer Rohrbau EFZ.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Fachgerechtes und wirtschaftliches Ausmessen, Herstellen und Montieren von anspruchsvollen Rohrleitungen und Stützsystemen im Rohrleitungsbau

• Erstellen von Isometrien und Rohrleitungssegmenten entsprechend den technischen Vorgaben und Projektanforderungen

• Planen und Organisieren der Arbeitsabläufe anhand von R&I‑Fliessbildern,  bei Projektarbeiten und Anlagenanpassungen

• Anwenden von PED‑Richtlinien sowie Arbeiten nach internen Rohrklassen, Werknormen und qualitätssichernden Vorgaben

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Anlagen- und Apparatebauer EFZ in Rohrleitungsbau, Rohrschlosser, Heizungsmonteur oder Sanitär-Installateur

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Rohrschlosser oder Vorrichter von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung

• Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team

• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation

• Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il supporto di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie come necessario.

Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Per la nostra posizione a Visp stiamo cercando un produttore di impianti e apparecchiature Rohrbau EFZ.

Cosa ti offriamo:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi benefici nelle aree di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali è disponibile anche su: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

I vostri compiti:

• Misurazione professionale ed economica, produzione e assemblaggio di oleodotti e sistemi di supporto impegnativi nella costruzione di tubazioni

• Creazione di segmenti isometrici e pipeline secondo specifiche tecniche e requisiti di progetto

• Pianificazione e organizzazione dei flussi di lavoro in base alle immagini di flusso R&I, al lavoro di progetto e alle regolazioni delle piante

• Applicare le linee guida PED e lavorare secondo le classi di tubi interni, standard di lavoro e specifiche di garanzia della qualità

Il tuo profilo:

• Formazione completa per il produttore di impianti e apparecchiature EFZ nella costruzione di tubazioni, fabbro di tubi, installatore di riscaldamento o installatore sanitario

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale come un fabbro di tubi o pretendente vantaggioso

• Prontezza per la formazione continua

• Godetevi il lavoro cross-departmental e il lavoro indipendente e flessibile in un team

jobs.description:
Werde Teil unseres Teams als Manufacturing Specialist 4-Schicht 80-100% (m/w/d) und unterstütze unsere mikrobiellen Produktionskampagnen aktiv mit deinem Fachwissen.
In dieser vielseitigen Rolle begleitest du Fermentations- und Aufreinigungskampagnen organisatorisch und technisch, stellst einen sicheren und effizienten Produktionsablauf sicher und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe durch organisatorische und technische Begleitung von Fermentations- und Aufreinigungskampagnen – mit Fokus auf Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheit

• Überwachung und Steuerung geplanter Prozessschritte während der Upstream- (Fermentation) und Downstream-Phasen

• Aktive Mitarbeit bei mikrobiellen Produktionsprozessen (z. B. Fermentation, Zellernte, Aufreinigung) unter Einhaltung der geltenden cGMP-Richtlinien – inklusive Fehlersuche, Ursachenanalyse und kontinuierlicher Prozessoptimierung

• Beitrag zu Risikobewertungen leisten und definierte Sicherheits- und Qualitätsmassnahmen umsetzen

• Fachliche Begleitung und Wissensvermittlung der Operatoren zu Anlagen und standardisierten Abläufen

• Sicherstellung, Überprüfung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Herstellvorschriften, SOPs und Batch-Dokumentationen

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor/Master) in Biotechnologie, Mikrobiologie oder Bio-/Chemieingenieurwesen

• Erfahrung in mikrobiellen Produktionsprozessen (insbesondere Fermentation und/oder Aufreinigung) ist von Vorteil

• GMP-Kenntnisse sind wünschenswert – oder die Bereitschaft, sich diese anzueignen

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im flexiblen 4-Schicht-System

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

• Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise – Sie bringen Ihre Ideen aktiv ein

Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben

• Laurea completa (Bachelor/Master) in Biotecnologia, Microbiologia o Ingegneria Bio-/Chemical

In this versatile role, you accompany fermentation and purification campaigns organizationally and technically, ensure a safe and efficient production process and work closely with different specialist areas.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Their tasks:

• Ensuring smooth processes through organisational and technical support of fermentation and purification campaigns – with a focus on quality, efficiency and safety

• Monitoring and controlling planned process steps during upstream (fermentation) and downstream phases

• Active participation in microbial production processes (e.g. fermentation, cell harvesting, purification) in compliance with the applicable cGMP guidelines – including troubleshooting, root cause analysis and continuous process optimization

• Contribute to risk assessments and implement defined safety and quality measures

• Professional support and knowledge transfer of operators on plants and standardized processes

• Ensuring, reviewing and continuous optimization of manufacturing regulations, SOPs and batch documentation

Your requirement profile:

• Completed degree (Bachelor/Master) in Biotechnology, Microbiology or Bio-/Chemical Engineering

• Experience in microbial production processes (especially fermentation and/or purification) is advantageous

• GMP knowledge is desirable – or the willingness to acquire it

• Readiness to work in the flexible 4-shift system

• Very good knowledge of German is required; English skills are beneficial

• Teamwork, communication strength and a structured, solution-oriented way of working – They actively contribute their ideas

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

We are looking to recruit a Manufacturing Lead (Director) to build up the operations organization for the Payload-Linker capacity expansion in Visp.  Leads a team of  production leaders, supervisors and specialists You will manage the operational readiness and provide leadership to the CQ-project team incl. the post OQ Start-up within the investment / Capex Project. After becoming operational, you will oversee the operational activities of the manufacturing unit with overall responsibility of manufacturing execution regarding safety, quality and on-time-in full delivery, as well as for the performance and results of the assigned area including cost control.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Lead a team of production managers (chemists/chemical engineers), supervisors, and specialists, with full responsibility for all aspects of people management, including qualification, development, coaching, hiring, compensation decisions, and performance or conduct issues.

• Manage the operational readiness within the CAPEX project and provide leadership to the CQ-project team incl. the post OQ Start-up

• Accountable for executing all production campaigns in the manufacturing unit, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and environmental requirements.

• Maintain oversight of production costs and provide POV forecasts for all campaigns within the area of responsibility. Contribute to budgeting and the preparation of product cost calculations for standard pricing.

• As a member of the Functional Leadership Team, support overall production management, including housekeeping, team conduct, training activities, and general operational controls.

• Serve as an operational specialist and regular point of contact for BU team members on production planning (S&OP), technical assessments, and feasibility requests.

• Responsible for routine performance monitoring, including weekly reports, dashboards, Hoshin boards, and other reporting tools.

What we are looking for:

• Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or equivalent) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.

• Demonstrated leadership skills with strong self-motivation, integrity, perseverance, and results orientation.

• Extensive experience in chemical manufacturing in the pharmaceutical industry, in leadership roles.

• Strong knowledge of GMP and EHS requirements.

• Fluency in English, German is an advantage

• Experience with Operational Excellence / LEAN principles is an advantage.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.description:
Manager, Manufacturing DSP 80%-100% (m/f/d)

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Lead manufacturing excellence in downstream processing (DSP) operations, driving performance, quality, and continuous improvement in a highly dynamic biopharmaceutical environment. This role offers the opportunity to shape team success while contributing to the delivery of life-saving therapies.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead and supervise a team of operations personnel, providing guidance, coaching, and performance management to foster a high-performing and engaged workforce

• Plan, organize, and monitor daily operational processes, including production scheduling, resource allocation, and workflow management

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including quality assurance, maintenance, and supply chain, to optimize performance and resolve issues

• Implement and enforce safety protocols, GMP, quality standards, and regulatory compliance

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and lead continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma)

• Monitor KPIs and prepare reports, driving data-based decisions and corrective actions

• Manage operational budgets and support training and development of team members

What we are looking for:

• Experience in manufacturing or pharmaceutical operations, including leadership responsibilities

• Strong understanding of GMP and regulatory requirements

• Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams to achieve operational excellence

• Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement (Lean/Six Sigma)

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Educational background in engineering, life sciences, business, or related field, or equivalent experience

• Fluency in English; German is a plus

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As a member of the QC Biologics, PhysChem Tech Team group in Visp, the Scientist (f/m/d) supports in analytical instrument qualification, promotes the adherence and continuous improvement of Quality Control and ensures lifecycle of the equipment

Key responsibilities:

• Initial qualification, requalification, service of the equipment, for the physical chemistry laboratory (centrifuges, balances, watherbaths, UV/VIS, photometer, turbidity, osmolality etc.) according to guidelines and procedures

• Planning and coordination of related activities

• Ensuring communication with the responsible QA and QC employees. Cooperation with laboratory analysts

• Triggering and processing of change requests, CAPA, deviations. Working in LIMS, Documentation Management System, and other required system, software

• Troubleshooting for the laboratory equipment

• Training for the laboratory analyst in usage of the equipment

Key requirements:

• Bachelor in chemistry, biotechnology, life science, or at least 1 year experience in laboratory with technical knowledge for the instruments

• At least several years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry

• Knowledge of analytical instrument qualification

• Strong background in cGMP regulations

• Structured, focused and well-organized working attitude. Open-minded for new ideas and suggestions, highly motivated and dynamic drive. Teamwork, as well flexibility for various tasks in technology team. Willing to learn

• Good verbal and written communication in German and English.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland.

What you will get

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Perform basic operational tasks in the lab (e.g mobile phase preparations, calibration of pH meter, balance check).

• Ensuring cleanliness and tidiness in the laboratory. This includes adherence to 6S principles and to cGMP standards for audit readiness

• Perform analytical testing within DPS Commercial QC (cGMP) for batch release and stability studies of drug products under cGMP according to existing method SOPs

• Document assay performance following Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) and flag relevant observations to the supervisor for further assessment

• Following applicable EHS regulations

What we are looking for:

• Training as lab technician (e.g. EFZ, CTA) or BSc in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field

• Willingness to learn and grow

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated QC laboratory is a plus

• Experience with HPLC, CE-SDS, icIEF, or ELISA is a plus

• Understanding of cGMP, GDocP, and Data Integrity principles

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

jobs.title: QC Project Manager
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses improve people's lives. In exchange, we let our people own their careers and genuinely make a difference.
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager, QC to act as the analytical champion for customer projects and provide scientific leadership across Quality Control activities. In this role, you will serve as the primary customer contact for analytical topics, lead method implementation and transfer activities, and support the successful delivery of development and manufacturing projects.

What you will get

• An opportunity to work on innovative pharmaceutical projects with global customers.

• A collaborative and inclusive work environment focused on continuous improvement.

• Exposure to cross-functional teams across QC, QA, Production, Analytical Development, and Supply Chain.

• Opportunities for professional growth and career development.

• A role with significant customer interaction and scientific leadership responsibilities.

• Competitive compensation and benefits package.

• The chance to contribute to improving lives through science.

What you will do

• Act as the primary customer interface for analytical topics throughout the project lifecycle.

• Lead method implementation, development, transfer, validation, and sample analysis activities across QC laboratories.

• Plan project activities and ensure objectives for quality, cost, and timelines are achieved.

• Estimate resources, project costs, and task durations while tracking key milestones.

• Resolve analytical and QC-related issues during development and manufacturing activities.

• Provide scientific expertise, data analysis, technical recommendations, and structured problem-solving support.

• Represent QC in customer meetings, audits, and cross-functional initiatives while supporting team development.

What we are looking for

• MSc or PhD in Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline.

• Experience in pharmaceutical Quality Control, or equivalent expertise gained through a PhD program.

• Strong knowledge of GMP requirements and regulated laboratory environments.

• Proven program or project management experience.

• Experience managing customer relationships and technical communications.

• Strong analytical problem-solving and scientific decision-making skills.

• Fluent English communication skills; German language skills are an advantage.

At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Success depends on how we work together, and we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.
Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a tremendous responsibility. We achieve this by combining scientific innovation with operational excellence.
Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusion, and respect for all individuals. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

Che cosa si otterrà

• Un'opportunità per lavorare su progetti farmaceutici innovativi con clienti globali.

• Un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e inclusivo focalizzato sul miglioramento continuo.

• Opportunità per la crescita professionale e lo sviluppo di carriera.

• Un ruolo con significative interazioni dei clienti e responsabilità di leadership scientifica.

• La possibilità di contribuire a migliorare la vita attraverso la scienza.

• Agire come interfaccia principale del cliente per argomenti analitici durante il ciclo di vita del progetto.

• Valutare le risorse, i costi del progetto e le durata del compito durante il monitoraggio delle pietre miliari chiave.

• Risolvere i problemi analitici e legati al QC durante le attività di sviluppo e produzione.

• Fornire competenze scientifiche, analisi dei dati, raccomandazioni tecniche e supporto strutturato problem-solving.

• Rappresentare QC nelle riunioni dei clienti, negli audit e nelle iniziative interfunzionali, supportando allo stesso tempo lo sviluppo del team.

Cosa stiamo cercando

• MSc o PhD in Scienze della Vita o una disciplina scientifica correlata.

• Esperienza nel controllo della qualità farmaceutica, o esperienza equivalente acquisita attraverso un programma di dottorato.

• Forte conoscenza dei requisiti GMP e degli ambienti di laboratorio regolamentati.

• Provata esperienza di programma o di gestione del progetto.

• Esperienza di gestione delle relazioni con i clienti e delle comunicazioni tecniche.

• Forte analitica problem-solving e competenze decisionali scientifiche.

• Capacità di comunicazione fluente inglese; competenze linguistiche tedesche sono un vantaggio.

A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Il successo dipende da come lavoriamo insieme, e ci impegniamo a creare un posto di lavoro inclusivo dove tutti possono contribuire e crescere.

• Repräsentieren Sie QC in Kundenbesprechungen, Audits und funktionsübergreifenden Initiativen und unterstützen Sie die Teamentwicklung.

• MSc oder PhD in Life Sciences oder einer verwandten wissenschaftlichen Disziplin.

jobs.description:
Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Als Deputy Head Site Protection & Rescue übernimmst du eine zentrale Führungs- und Steuerungsfunktion innerhalb der Site Protection & Rescue Organisation. Du verantwortest die operative Führung der Werkfeuerwehr, die Aus- und Weiterbildung der Einsatzkräfte sowie die Organisation des Pikettdienstes. Im Ereignis- und Notfall leitest du Einsätze als Gesamteinsatzleiter und sorgst für eine sichere, professionelle und effiziente Einsatzbewältigung am Standort.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Planung, Organisation und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Aus- und Weiterbildung der Werkfeuerwehr sowie Schulung der Mitarbeitenden in den Bereichen Brandbekämpfung, Erstintervention, Evakuation sowie Selbst- und Fremdschutz.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher, behördlicher und interner Ausbildungsstandards sowie der vollständigen Dokumentation von Qualifikationen und Ausbildungsnachweisen.

• Planung und Leitung von Übungen, Szenarientrainings und Grossübungen sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Ausbildungskonzepte.

• Führung von Einsätzen als Gesamteinsatzleiter oder in einer anderen Führungsfunktion sowie Koordination der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Einsatzorganisationen und Behörden.

• Mitwirkung in der Krisen- und Ereignisorganisation, Durchführung von Einsatzanalysen sowie Ableitung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen.

• Verantwortung für die Planung und Sicherstellung des Pikettdienstes, die Koordination von Ressourcen sowie die Optimierung von Alarmierungs- und Einsatzprozessen.

• Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung der Einsatzkräfte sowie Förderung einer leistungsorientierten Sicherheits- und Führungskultur.

• Unterstützung des Head Site Protection & Rescue bei personellen, organisatorischen und strategischen Führungsaufgaben.

• Verantwortung für Einsatzdokumentation, Verrechnung, Entschädigung der Einsatzkräfte sowie Unterstützung der Budgetplanung, Kostenkontrolle und des Reportings.

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung mit technischem oder chemischem Hintergrund.

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Feuerwehrinstruktor/in FKS.

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der chemischen Industrie.

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung als Offizier/in einer Werk- oder Stützpunktfeuerwehr.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Einsatz-, Notfall- und Krisenmanagement.

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

As Deputy Head Site Protection & Rescue, you take on a central management and control function within the Site Protection & Rescue organization. You are responsible for the operational management of the fire brigade, the training and further education of the emergency forces as well as the organization of the Picettdienst. In the event and emergency, you will lead missions as the overall mission manager and ensure safe, professional and efficient mission management at the site.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Your tasks:

• Planning, organisation and continuous development of the training and further education of the fire brigade as well as training of employees in the areas of firefighting, initial intervention, evacuation and self- and external protection.

• Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory and internal training standards and complete documentation of qualifications and evidence of formal qualifications.

• Planning and management of exercises, scenario training and major exercises as well as continuous development of training concepts.

• conduct operations as Commander-in-Chief or in any other management capacity, and coordinate cooperation with internal and external operational organisations and authorities.

• Participation in crisis and event organisation, implementation of mission analyses and derivation and implementation of improvement measures.

• Responsibility for planning and securing the Picett service, coordinating resources and optimizing alerting and deployment processes.

• Professional and disciplinary leadership of emergency responders and promotion of a performance-oriented security and leadership culture.

• Support of the Head Site Protection & Rescue in personnel, organizational and strategic management tasks.

• Responsibility for operational documentation, accounting, compensation of operational forces as well as support for budget planning, cost control and reporting.

Your profile:

• Completed professional training with a technical or chemical background.

• Completed training as Fire Instructor/FKS.

• Several years of professional experience in the chemical industry.

• At least five years of experience as an officer/works or base fire brigade.

• In-depth knowledge of operational, emergency and crisis management.

jobs.description:
Mit einem Praktikum bzw. einer Bachelorarbeit im Bereich Umweltschutz bei Lonza hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem hochdynamischen industriellen Umfeld einen direkten Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Abwasserbehandlung zu leisten. Dabei arbeitest du an einer praxisnahen und zukunftsorientierten Fragestellung zur biologischen Abwasserreinigung und erhältst spannende Einblicke in die vielfältigen Herausforderungen der industriellen Umwelttechnik.

Im Rahmen deiner Bachelorarbeit entwickelst du einen Test zur Modellierung einer Nitrifikationsstufe. Dabei begleitest du den gesamten Prozess – von der Versuchsplanung über den Laboraufbau bis hin zur Datenauswertung und Interpretation der Ergebnisse. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Fachpersonen aus dem Bereich Umweltschutz und Abwasserbehandlung, sowie der Fachhochschule, zusammen und übernimmst Verantwortung für eigene Arbeitspakete.

Was auf dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort

Deine Aufgaben

• Entwicklung und Durchführung eines Tests zur Modellierung einer Nitrifikationsstufe

• Selbstständige Planung, Erstellung und Optimierung eines geeigneten Labor-Set-ups

• Ausarbeitung und Umsetzung von Probenahme- und Analysekonzepten

• Auswertung, Interpretation und Dokumentation der Versuchsergebnisse

• Erstellung von technischen Berichten und Präsentationen

Unsere Anforderungen:

• Laufendes Studium (Bachelor) in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

• Interesse an biologischen Abwasserreinigungsprozessen und Umwelttechnologien

• Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Hohe Eigeninitiative sowie Freude daran, neue Themen zu erlernen

• Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit

• Agilität und Flexibilität in einem dynamischen Industrieumfeld

• Gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten sowie sicherer Umgang mit IT-Tools

• Sorgfältiger und verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit Daten und Informationen

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten?
Jetzt bewerben

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Con uno stage o una tesi di laurea nel campo della protezione ambientale a Lonza, hai la possibilità di dare un contributo diretto al trattamento sostenibile delle acque reflue in un ambiente industriale altamente dinamico. Si lavorerà su una questione pratica e orientata al futuro del trattamento delle acque reflue biologiche e acquisirà interessanti informazioni sulle diverse sfide della tecnologia ambientale industriale.

Come parte della vostra tesi di laurea, si sviluppa un test per modellare un livello di nitrificazione. Si accompagna l'intero processo – dalla pianificazione sperimentale alla configurazione di laboratorio alla valutazione dei dati e all'interpretazione dei risultati. Lavorate a stretto contatto con specialisti esperti nel campo della protezione ambientale e del trattamento delle acque reflue, nonché con l'università delle scienze applicate e assumetevi la responsabilità dei vostri pacchetti di lavoro.

Cosa ti aspetta:

• Una cura Agile e cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Una varietà di vantaggi, a seconda della funzione e della posizione

I tuoi compiti

• Sviluppo e attuazione di un test per modellare una fase di nitrificazione

• Pianificazione indipendente, creazione e ottimizzazione di un adeguato impianto di laboratorio

• Sviluppo e realizzazione di piani di campionamento e analisi

• Valutazione, interpretazione e documentazione dei risultati sperimentali

• Preparazione di relazioni e presentazioni tecniche

I nostri requisiti:

• Studi in corso (bachelor) in scienze ambientali, ingegneria ambientale, ingegneria dei processi, ingegneria chimica o un corso di laurea comparabile

• Interessi dei processi biologici di trattamento delle acque reflue e delle tecnologie ambientali

• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

• Alta iniziativa e piacere nell'apprendimento di nuovi argomenti

• Forza di comunicazione e lavoro di squadra

• Agility e flessibilità in un ambiente industriale dinamico

• Buone capacità organizzative e gestione sicura degli strumenti IT

• Gestione attenta e responsabile dei dati e delle informazioni

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.

With an internship or a bachelor thesis in the field of environmental protection at Lonza, you have the opportunity to make a direct contribution to sustainable wastewater treatment in a highly dynamic industrial environment. You will work on a practical and future-oriented question of biological wastewater treatment and gain exciting insights into the diverse challenges of industrial environmental technology.

As part of your bachelor thesis, you develop a test to model a nitrification level. You accompany the entire process – from experimental planning to laboratory setup to data evaluation and interpretation of the results. You work closely with experienced specialists in the field of environmental protection and wastewater treatment, as well as the university of applied sciences, and take responsibility for your own work packages.

What is waiting for you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location

Your tasks

• Development and implementation of a test to model a nitrification stage

• Independent planning, creation and optimization of a suitable laboratory set-up

• Development and implementation of sampling and analysis plans

• Evaluation, interpretation and documentation of experimental results

• Preparation of technical reports and presentations

Our requirements:

• Ongoing studies (bachelor) in environmental sciences, environmental engineering, process engineering, chemical engineering or a comparable degree program

• Interest in biological wastewater treatment processes and environmental technologies

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method

• High initiative and pleasure in learning new topics

• Communication strength and teamwork

• Agility and flexibility in a dynamic industrial environment

• Good organizational skills and safe handling of IT tools

• Careful and responsible handling of data and information

• Good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

You will lead the development, qualification, validation, and implementation of automated and semi-automated inspection and container closure integrity testing processes, ensuring robust defect detection and product quality from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity for someone who thrives in a pioneering environment, enjoys building processes from scratch with limited guidance, and wants to help shape the future of a growing Drug Product manufacturing site. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Support the production staff on the shopfloor by providing scientific expertise

• Support the GMP compliant qualification and validation activities of automated visual inspection system from an Operations perspective

• Prepare readiness for operative takeover of the automated, semi-automated, manual visual inspection and container closure integrity testing

• Accountable for safety, compliance and regulatory aspects. Preparation of risk analysis and all relevant procedures to ensure regulatory compliance and achieve business goals.

• Technical improvement execution: Execute improvements, Drive process related trouble shooting

• Leading/participate in change controls and deviations: using scientific and statistical knowledge to analyze data to provide process understanding, and to identify root causes of product and process failures.

• Represent the VI and CCIT during regulatory inspections and audits.

What we are looking for:

• Proven hands-on experience in pharmaceutical visual inspection for drug product in vials or syringes, in EITHER manual visual inspection, semi-automated, and/or fully automated visual inspection machines (AVI); experience across multiple inspection technologies is highly preferred.

• Knowledge of qualification of visual inspection machines, product validation and ideally with Container Closure Integrity Testing (CCIT) is preferred.

• Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment, building processes, standards, and solutions from the ground up with limited guidance and a strong continuous improvement mindset.

• Fluent in EITHER English OR German is required (fluency in both languages is an advantage)

• A relevant scientific or engineering degree is preferred, although equivalent technical training combined with substantial industry experience will also be considered.

• Unterstützung der GMP-konformen Qualifizierungs- und Validierungsaktivitäten des automatisierten visuellen Inspektionssystems aus operativer Perspektive

• Verantwortlich für Sicherheits-, Compliance- und regulatorische Aspekte. Erstellung einer Risikoanalyse und aller relevanten Verfahren zur Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Vorschriften und zur Erreichung der Geschäftsziele.

• Vertretung des VI und des CCIT bei regulatorischen Inspektionen und Audits.

Was wir suchen:

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig in einer dynamischen Umgebung zu arbeiten, Prozesse, Standards und Lösungen von Grund auf mit begrenzter Anleitung und einer starken Denkweise zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung aufzubauen.

• Ein relevanter wissenschaftlicher oder technischer Abschluss wird bevorzugt, obwohl auch eine gleichwertige technische Ausbildung in Kombination mit erheblicher Branchenerfahrung in Betracht gezogen wird.

Über Lonza

Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Stein, AG, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

Vous dirigerez le développement, la qualification, la validation et la mise en oeuvre de processus automatisés et semi-automatisés d'inspection et de contrôle de l'intégrité de la fermeture des contenants, assurant ainsi une détection robuste des défauts et la qualité du produit à partir du sol. C'est une occasion unique pour quelqu'un qui prospère dans un environnement pionnier, aime construire des processus à partir de zéro avec des conseils limités, et veut aider à façonner l'avenir d'un site de fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques en croissance. C'est un rôle entièrement basé sur le site. Travailler ensemble en personne soutient une collaboration étroite en temps réel et la précision technique nécessaire pour fabriquer des médicaments répondant aux normes de qualité et de sécurité les plus élevées.

• La connaissance de la qualification des machines d'inspection visuelle, de la validation des produits et, idéalement, des essais d'intégrité de fermeture des contenants (CCIT) est privilégiée.

• Capacité de travailler de façon autonome dans un environnement dynamique, de construire des processus, des normes et des solutions à partir de la base avec une orientation limitée et une forte amélioration continue de la mentalité.

• La maîtrise de l'anglais ou de l'allemand est requise (la maîtrise des deux langues est un avantage)

• Un diplôme scientifique ou technique pertinent est préféré, bien qu'une formation technique équivalente combinée à une expérience importante de l'industrie soit également envisagée.

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp  wird ein/e Laborant/in der QC Mikrobiologie gesucht. Als Mitglied unseres jungen und dynamischen Mikrobiologie-Teams, bist du unter Einhaltung der GMP- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien verantwortliche für die Routine-Durchführung von verschiedenen mikrobiologischen Methoden.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Durchführung analytischer Methoden im Aufgabenbereich, Auswertung, Review und Berichten der Ergebnisse.

• Erstellen von Analysenprotokollen, Prüfanweisungen und Kurzberichten.

• Dokumentation aller Labortätigkeiten entsprechend GMP und internen Richtlinien.

• Einhaltung der Qualitäts- (SOP und GMP) und der Sicherheitsvorschriften.

• Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor.

• Methodischer Hauptfokus: Keim Identifizierungen und Endotoxin Messungen.

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in, BTA, oder BSC mit Fachrichtung Biologie, Biochemie oder ähnlichem Bereich.

• Fliessend Deutsch und English von Vorteil.

• Hands-on Labor Erfahrung (insbesondere Erfahrung mit mikrobiologischen Analysetechniken) sind ein Plus.

• Kenntnisse im Bereich GMP ist ein Plus .

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

As an Automation Technician (m/f/d) at our sterile production site in Stein, Canton Aargau, you play a central role in ensuring the operational readiness, reliability and compliance of the HVAC and supply systems that support pharmaceutical production. In this position, you contribute to safe, efficient and compliant processes while ensuring high standards of quality and technical excellence.

What is waiting for you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• providing first-level support, maintenance and troubleshooting for assigned automation-related systems; Close cooperation with mechanics teams to solve technical problems

• Implementation and documentation of maintenance, calibration and commissioning work according to safety, cGMP and regulatory requirements

• Monitoring and controlling automated production and plant processes to ensure stable and reliable operation

• Contribute to sustainable programs and tools that improve asset usability, system reliability and long-term performance

• Solid MS Office skills (in particular Excel); SAP‐PM and CMX are a plus

Your career at Lonza in Visp

• Perform Periodic Review of Qualified Units Based on Specifications

jobs.title: Manufacturing Specialist Mammalian (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for several Manufacturing Specialists for our Ibex-facility. In this role, you will be responsible for executing operational activities of assigned manufacturing projects in specific areas (Up-stream or Down-stream processing).

Key responsibilities:

• Execute manufacturing activities in either the Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing area according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Support the preparation of SHE (Safety, Health, environment), EM (Environmental Monitoring), operation and cleaning risk assessment for the assigned products and the implementation and control of defined measures

• Assist document preparation (e.g. electronic batch records, SOPs) specific to the assigned production area

• Review production documentation and work on deviations, change requests and implementation of CAPAs to ensure high-quality GMP standards

• Engage in Capital investment projects for building and commissioning of new manufacturing units as manufacturing expert. Responsible for delivering all input required for the specific set-up, commissioning and qualification of the manufacturing suites and equipment

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or corresponding training qualification, Bachelor / Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering or related disciplines is an advantage

• Sound knowledge of biotechnological processes either in the area of microbial and/or mammalian cultivation or in the area protein purification

• Excellent communication skills, team player, driven and solution-oriented

• Fluency in English required, fluency in German is considered a plus

• Open to work in shift (4-shift system)

• Basic GMP understanding is a plus

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face increasing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing or BioConjugate Manufacturing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian or microbial cells (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

• Responsible for entire processes or process units for clinical and commercial manufacturing projects in therapeutic BioConjugates like Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Working experience in biomanufacturing would be an advantage

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Specialist Vibe-X (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

A new production plant in the field of biotechnological production is being built at the Visp site. This is an exciting time to join our team. We’re seeking motivated and resilient individuals to play a key role in vaccine production—both during the project phase and as we transition to routine operations.
Join us as a Manufacturing Specialist – Opportunities for All Experience Levels!

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you’ll do:
during the project phase

• Support the project team in defining and setting up innovative vaccine production processes.

• Collaborate on the qualification and validation of new production areas and processes.

in routine production

• Execute manufacturing activities in either the Upstream Processing, the Downstream Processing or the Bioconjugates area according to cGMP and SOPs guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Support the preparation of SHE (Safety, Health, environment), EM (Environmental Monitoring), operation and cleaning risk assessment for the assigned products and the implementation and control of defined measures

• Assist document preparation (e.g. electronic batch records, SOPs) specific to the assigned production area

• Review production documentation and work on deviations, change requests and implementation of CAPAs to ensure high-quality GMP standards

• Engage in Capital investment projects for building and commissioning of new manufacturing units as manufacturing expert. Responsible for delivering all input required for the specific set-up, commissioning and qualification of the manufacturing suites and equipment

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

What we’re looking for:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or corresponding training qualification, Bachelor / Master's degree in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering or several years of relevant professional experience in related subject areas is an advantage

• Sound knowledge of biotechnological processes either in the area of microbial and/or mammalian cultivation, in the area protein purification or the Bioconjugates area

• Excellent communication skills, great teammate, driven and solution-oriented

• Fluency in English required, fluency in German is considered a plus

• Open to work in shift (4-shift system)

• Basic GMP understanding is a plus

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

• Conoscenza sonora dei processi biotecnologici nell'area della coltivazione microbica e/o mammifera, nella depurazione delle proteine o nell'area Bioconjugates
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, grande compagno di squadra, guidato e orientato alla soluzione
• Fluency in inglese richiesto, la fluenza in tedesco è considerato un plus

Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente. La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, status veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.
