jobs.title: Scientist QC Biochemistry 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Ort: Visp (Schweiz)

Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten!

Wir suchen ein/e Wissenschaftler/in (m/w/d) für den Bereich Biochemie/Bioanalytics innerhalb der Qualitätskontrolle gesucht.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben wettbewerbsfähigen Gehältern finden Sie eine breite Palette an Lifestyle-, Familien- und Freizeitvorteilen. Je nach Standort können diese Vorteile Familienzulagen, Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung, Rabatte für lokale Unternehmen und Attraktionen, Reisekostenzuschüsse und subventionierte Mahlzeiten umfassen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Wissenschaftliche Leitung bestehender Projekte, sowie Implementierung, Transfer und Validierung neuer analytischer Methoden mit Schwerpunkt in Biochemie

• Fachliche Expertise bei technischen und analytischen Fragestellungen, sowie die Bearbeitung von Untersuchungen, Änderungsanträgen und Abweichungen unter cGMP

• Planung und Mitverantwortung bei der Durchführung der Freigabeanalytik

• Extraktion und Auswertung von analytischen Daten, wie auch Verfassen von Berichten und Präsentationen

• Erstellung, Überprüfung und Freigabe von Dokumenten zur Sicherstellung der Einhaltung behördlicher Richtlinien

• Repräsentant für projektspezifische Anfragen in Kundenaudits und Behördeninspektionen

• Bereitschaftsdienst mit vorab vereinbarten Einsätzen im Rahmen des Pikettdiensts

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (MSc/PhD) im Bereich Chemie, Biochemie oder Biologie

• Sie haben Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Qualitätskontrolle und sind vertraut mit den entsprechenden Prozessen unter GMP und in der Analytik von Proteinen

• Sie sind selbständig, verantwortungsbewusst und besitzen eine gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

• Sie haben Spass daran, sich in ein junges, dynamisches Team einzubringen, sind engagiert, denken voraus und besitzen Eigeninitiative

• Sie beherrschen die deutsche Sprache und verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione: Visp (Svizzera) Se necessario, il sostegno è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie quando si muovono. Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo essere parte di! Stiamo cercando uno scienziato (m/f/d) per la biochimica/bioanalitica all'interno del controllo di qualità. Cosa ti offriamo:
• Una carriera Agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica
• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico
• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni
• Oltre agli stipendi competitivi, troverete una vasta gamma di benefici per lo stile di vita, la famiglia e il tempo libero. A seconda della posizione, queste prestazioni possono includere assegni familiari, assistenza all'infanzia, sconti per le imprese locali e le attrazioni, indennità di viaggio e pasti sovvenzionati. I loro compiti:
• Gestione scientifica dei progetti esistenti, nonché implementazione, trasferimento e convalida di nuovi metodi analitici con particolare attenzione alla biochimica
• Competenza in questioni tecniche e analitiche, nonché il trattamento delle indagini, delle richieste di cambiamento e delle deviazioni in cGMP
• Pianificazione e corresponsabilità nell'attuazione dell'analisi di rilascio
• Estrazione e valutazione dei dati analitici, nonché scrittura di report e presentazioni
• Creare, rivedere e rilasciare documenti per garantire la conformità normativa
• Rappresentante per le richieste specifiche del progetto nei controlli dei clienti e nelle ispezioni governative
• Servizio standby con distribuzioni pre concordate nel quadro del Pikettdienst Il vostro profilo di requisito:
• Hai completato gli studi (MSc/PhD) nel campo della chimica, della biochimica o della biologia
• Hai esperienza professionale nel campo del controllo della qualità e conosci i processi corrispondenti sotto GMP e nell'analisi delle proteine
• Sono lavoratori autonomi, responsabili e hanno una buona capacità di comunicare e lavorare in un team e godere della cooperazione interdisciplinare.
• Godono di essere coinvolti in un team giovane e dinamico, sono impegnati, pensano avanti e hanno la propria iniziativa
• Hai imparato la lingua tedesca e sei sicuro di negoziare l'inglese per completare il tuo profilo I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile. Lonza è unito da persone che assumono sfide e usano la loro creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo offre loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of! We are looking for a scientist (m/f/d) for biochemistry/bioanalytics within quality control. What we offer you:

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• In addition to competitive salaries, you will find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits. jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As a Training Specialist, you act as the key link between employees and the training process, owning your departments as a subject matter expert and ensuring compliant management of Cornerstone and GMP training activities. You design engaging training content, deliver impactful sessions, and partner with stakeholders while onboarding every new hire—offering broad exposure, strong social interaction, and meaningful influence across the organization. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Needs Assessment: Conduct organizational assessments to identify training needs and gaps, collaborating with department heads and managers.

• Curriculum Design: Develop training curricula, including course outlines, instructional materials, and assessment tools. Keep abreast of the latest trends and technologies in training and development to ensure programs remain current.

• Training Delivery: Facilitate training sessions using a variety of instructional techniques, such as classroom training, virtual training, on-the-job coaching, and e-learning.

• Evaluation: Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs, utilizing relevant evaluation tools like surveys and assessments.

• Documentation: Maintain comprehensive records of training activities, materials, and participant progress. Ensure all training activities and materials meet compliance standards and regulations.

• Resource Management: Manage training resources, including venues, equipment, and materials, ensuring optimal utilization. Leverage Learning Management Systems (LMS) to schedule, track, and report on training activities.

• Stakeholder Communication: Regularly communicate with key stakeholders on training progress, challenges, and outcomes.

What we are looking for:

• Strong background in GMP (e.g., QA, Manufacturing, QC, or similar) or 2–4 years of hands-on experience in training/learning roles in a GMP environment

• Fluent in English (essential) and German, with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse audiences

• Passion for collaborating with people and building strong relationships across departments and functions

• Structured, detail-oriented mindset with a high level of compliance awareness and ownership

• Experience with tools such as Articulate, Cornerstone, Veeva, or TrackWise, and knowledge of sterile fill & finish processes is a plus

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé. En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices Ce que vous ferez :
• Évaluation des besoins : Effectuer des évaluations organisationnelles pour cerner les besoins et les lacunes en matière de formation, en collaboration avec les chefs de département et les gestionnaires.
• Conception des programmes : Élaborer des programmes de formation, y compris des plans de cours, du matériel didactique et des outils d'évaluation. Tenez-vous au courant des dernières tendances et technologies en matière de formation et de perfectionnement pour s'assurer que les programmes demeurent à jour.
• Prestation de la formation : Faciliter les séances de formation en utilisant diverses techniques pédagogiques, comme la formation en classe, la formation virtuelle, l'encadrement en cours d'emploi et l'apprentissage en ligne.
• Évaluation : Surveiller et évaluer l'efficacité des programmes de formation en utilisant des outils d'évaluation pertinents comme les enquêtes et les évaluations.
• Documentation : Tenir des registres complets des activités de formation, du matériel et des progrès réalisés par les participants. Veiller à ce que toutes les activités et tous les documents de formation respectent les normes et les règlements de conformité.
• Gestion des ressources : Gérer les ressources de formation, y compris les lieux, l'équipement et le matériel, en assurant une utilisation optimale. Tirer parti des systèmes de gestion de l'apprentissage (SGL) pour planifier, suivre et rendre compte des activités de formation.
• Communication avec les intervenants : Communiquer régulièrement avec les intervenants clés sur les progrès, les défis et les résultats de la formation. Ce que nous cherchons:
• Forte expérience en BPF (p. ex., AQ, Fabrication, QC, ou similaire) ou de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience pratique dans la formation et l'apprentissage des rôles dans un environnement BPF
• Fluent en anglais (essentiel) et en allemand, avec la capacité de communiquer clairement entre différents publics
• Passion de collaboration avec les gens et d'établissement de solides relations entre les ministères et les fonctions
• Un état d'esprit structuré et axé sur les détails, avec un niveau élevé de sensibilisation à la conformité et d'appropriation

Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez. L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord. Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: Leiter - Unterhaltswerkstatt 80-100% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Für unseren Standort Visp suchen wir eine engagierte Führungskraft als Gruppenleiter Werkstatt.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: assetstream.aspx

Deine Aufgaben:

• Fachliche und organisatorische Leitung der Werkstatt IH-Pharma H23 gemäss Unternehmens- und Werkstattstrategie

• Sicherstellung einer effizienten, termingerechten und wirtschaftlichen Auftragsabwicklung

• Führung, Entwicklung und Einsatzplanung der Mitarbeitenden inkl. Lernender und externer Ressourcen sowie Verantwortung für die Einhaltung aller Sicherheitsvorgaben

• Budgetverantwortung sowie Steuerung und Überwachung der zugehörigen Kostenstellen

• Sicherstellung des Betriebs, Unterhalts und der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Werkstattinfrastruktur

• Initiierung und Umsetzung von KVP- und Optimierungsprojekten inkl. Analyse bestehender Prozesse und Einführung neuer Standards, Technologien und Arbeitsmethoden

• Dokumentation, Auswertung und Präsentation von Projekten sowie aktive Mitwirkung in bereichsübergreifenden Entscheidungsprozessen

• Stellvertretung des Head Workshops & Standards sowie Mitarbeit in strategischen Meetings und in der bereichsübergreifenden Koordination

• Sicherstellung der Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation zwischen Werkstattgruppen sowie mit Schnittstellen wie Engineering, Produktion, EHS und HR

• Mitwirkung bei Behörden-, Kunden- und Qualitätsaudits sowie Koordination externer Dienstleister und Lieferanten

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung in Führung oder Projektmanagement

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Werkstattleitung oder Instandhaltung

• Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten

• Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterbildung

• Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Optimierungsprojekten

• Hohe Eigeninitiative, Belastbarkeit und Teamorientierung

• Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.
Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Operations Support Manufacturing Specialist
jobs.description:
Operations Support: Manufacturing Specialist, Operations Support, Large Scale Mammalian

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula for how we do it. Our greatest scientific solutions are dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for Operations Support and Manufacturing Specialists for our 6 x 20K Large Scale Mammalian Facility. In this role, you will be responsible for performing operational support activities within the Operations Support Team in partnership with Buffer Media Supply, USP, and DSP.

What you’ll do:

• Assignments within the Operations Support team focused on receipt and management of raw materials, single use materials, dispensing of small volume and large-scale medias and buffers to meet production demands and adherence to schedule.

• Processing of parts in washers and autoclaves

• Transport and storage of materials within temperature-controlled requirements

• Execution of tasks in compliance with safety regulations and cGMP quality requirements.

• Execution of production steps including interaction with HMIs and automated systems

Key responsibilities:

• Complete manufacturing activities in Operations Support area according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our manufacturing team where you will lead and optimize GMP production processes while contributing to impactful projects from tech transfer through clinical production. This role offers the opportunity to drive operational excellence and work at the forefront of biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

Site-based
This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location

• Learn more: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Act as a manufacturing expert within a multidisciplinary project team, supporting projects from tech transfer through clinical production

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across quality, cost, efficiency, and safety using operational excellence methodologies

• Represent the Lonza manufacturing unit during customer audits and site visits

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including QA, MSAT, and Engineering

• Support knowledge transfer, mentoring, and leadership within the production environment

• Ensure adherence to regulatory and quality standards in all production activities

What we are looking for

• Bachelor or Master’s or PhD degree in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Chemical Engineering, or a related field

• Strong leadership skills with the ability to guide teams in a GMP-regulated environment

• Experience in GMP manufacturing (preferred but not mandatory)

• Fluency in German and English

• Strong communication and collaboration skills across functions and stakeholders

• Continuous improvement mindset with focus on operational excellence

• Ability to work in complex, fast-paced project environments

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for an Executive Director, Quality Site Head, Stein.

Role Purpose:

The Quality Site Head is a key member of the site leadership team and is responsible for leading, developing, and continuously improving all quality-related activities across the site. As the organization expands its Drug Product (DP) manufacturing capabilities and scales operations, this role will provide strategic and operational quality leadership to ensure the highest standards of product quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and business performance.

The Quality Site Head will drive the site's quality culture, strengthen organizational capabilities, and ensure alignment with global quality strategies while supporting the successful growth of a world-class Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). The role will play a critical part in preparing the site for future expansion, regulatory inspections, customer audits, and increasing manufacturing complexity.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Leadership & Site Governance

• Serve as the senior quality leader for the site and a trusted advisor to the Site Head and leadership team.

• Define and execute the site's quality strategy in alignment with global quality objectives and business priorities.

• Lead all Quality functions, including Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Compliance, Validation, and Quality Systems.

• Foster a proactive quality culture that promotes accountability, continuous improvement, and patient-centric decision-making.

• Build and develop a high-performing quality organization capable of supporting significant site growth and increasing operational complexity.

Drug Product Quality Leadership

• Lead and strengthen all quality activities related to Drug Product manufacturing, packaging, testing, release, and lifecycle management.

• Ensure compliance with current GxP requirements, FDA, EMA, Swissmedic, and other applicable global regulatory standards.

• Provide expert guidance on quality aspects of aseptic processing, sterile manufacturing, biologics, and advanced Drug Product technologies, as applicable.

• Partner closely with Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Technical Services to ensure robust quality oversight throughout the product lifecycle.

• Spend time on the shopfloor in Gemba's acting as a coach.

Organizational Growth & Capability Development

• Develop the quality organization to support the site's growth from approximately 500 to 1,000 employees.

• Assess organizational capabilities and identify competency gaps across quality functions.

• Implement talent development, succession planning, coaching, and training programs to build future leadership capabilities.

• Attract, retain, and develop top-quality talent while fostering a culture of engagement, collaboration, and innovation.

• Work shoulder to shoulder with the site head championing quality culture.

Regulatory Compliance, Audits & Inspections

• Ensure inspection readiness at all times and maintain a robust quality management system.

• Lead and oversee regulatory inspections, customer audits, and corporate quality assessments.

• Act as the primary quality representative during interactions with regulatory authorities and key customers.

• Ensure timely and effective investigation, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across all quality processes and systems.

• Promote the use of modern quality methodologies and digital quality tools, including Six Sigma, Lean principles, FMEA, SPC, and advanced analytics.

• Ensure effective management of deviations, change controls, complaints, CAPAs, risk assessments, and product quality reviews.

• Establish and monitor meaningful quality performance indicators to drive operational excellence and business performance.

Risk Management & Decision Making

• Apply science- and risk-based approaches to quality oversight and decision-making.

• Anticipate and proactively mitigate quality and compliance risks associated with site growth, new technologies, and customer programs.

• Ensure effective escalation and resolution of critical quality issues while balancing patient safety, compliance, and business objectives.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong partnerships with customers, serving as a key quality representative for strategic client relationships.

• Collaborate closely with other site quality leaders and global quality teams to harmonize standards, processes, and best practices.

• Support business development activities, customer visits, due diligence assessments, and new product introductions.

• Represent the site within global quality networks and industry forums.

Industry & Regulatory Leadership

• Monitor emerging regulatory requirements, industry trends, and technological advancements impacting Drug Product manufacturing.

• Translate industry developments into practical quality strategies and operational improvements.

• Champion innovation and modernization initiatives that strengthen the site's competitive position within the CDMO market.

• Act as a visible leader internally and externally, representing Lonza at industry, regulatory, and community levels.

Key Requirements and Qualifications

• Master's degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Quality Management, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced qualifications in quality, regulatory affairs, or business leadership are considered advantageous.

• Several years’ of progressive leadership experience within pharmaceutical quality organizations.

• Many years’ in a senior quality leadership role with direct responsibility for site-wide quality operations.

• Demonstrated expertise in Drug Product manufacturing within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CDMO environment.

• Proven track record of successfully leading regulatory inspections by FDA, EMA, Swissmedic, and other global health authorities.

• Experience supporting large-scale site expansions, organizational transformation, or significant operational growth is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of biologics, sterile manufacturing, aseptic processing, and modern pharmaceutical quality systems.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte. Stiamo cercando un direttore esecutivo, responsabile del sito di qualità, Stein. Scopo del ruolo: Il Quality Site Head è un membro chiave del team di leadership del sito ed è responsabile di leader, sviluppo e miglioramento continuo di tutte le attività legate alla qualità in tutto il sito. Man mano che l'organizzazione amplia le proprie capacità di produzione e le sue operazioni di scala e di produzione di prodotti farmaceutici, questo ruolo fornirà leadership strategica e operativa di qualità per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità del prodotto, sicurezza del paziente, conformità normativa e prestazioni aziendali. La Quality Site Head guiderà la cultura della qualità del sito, rafforzerà le capacità organizzative e garantirà l'allineamento con le strategie di qualità globali, supportando al contempo la crescita di un'Organizzazione mondiale per lo sviluppo e la produzione dei contratti (CDMO). Il ruolo svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella preparazione del sito per future espansioni, ispezioni normative, audit dei clienti e crescente complessità di produzione. Responsabilità chiave: Leadership della qualità & Governance del sito
• Servire come leader di qualità senior per il sito e un consulente affidabile per il team di Site Head e leadership.
• Definire ed eseguire la strategia di qualità del sito in linea con gli obiettivi di qualità globali e le priorità aziendali.
• Condurre tutte le funzioni di qualità, tra cui garanzia di qualità, controllo di qualità, conformità, convalida e sistemi di qualità.
• Promuovere una cultura di qualità proattiva che promuove la responsabilità, il miglioramento continuo e il processo decisionale paziente-centrico.
• Costruire e sviluppare un'organizzazione di alta qualità in grado di supportare una crescita significativa del sito e una maggiore complessità operativa. Leadership della qualità del prodotto
• Guidare e rafforzare tutte le attività di qualità relative alla produzione, imballaggio, test, rilascio e gestione del ciclo di vita.
• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti GxP attuali, FDA, EMA, Swissmedic e altri standard normativi globali applicabili.
• Fornire una guida esperta sugli aspetti di qualità della lavorazione asettica, della produzione sterile, della biologia e delle tecnologie avanzate del prodotto della droga, come applicabile.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain e Servizi Tecnici per garantire una robusta supervisione della qualità durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Trascorrete il tempo sul pavimento del negozio a Gemba che si comporta da allenatore. Sviluppo organizzativo della crescita e della capacità
• Sviluppare l'organizzazione di qualità per sostenere la crescita del sito da circa 500 a 1.000 dipendenti.
• Valutare le capacità organizzative e identificare le lacune di competenze tra le funzioni di qualità.
• Attuazione dello sviluppo del talento, pianificazione della successione, coaching e programmi di formazione per costruire le capacità di leadership future.
• Attrarre, conservare e sviluppare talenti di alta qualità, promuovendo una cultura di impegno, collaborazione e innovazione.
• Lavoro spalla a spalla con la testa del sito che sostiene la cultura di qualità. Compliance regolamentare, Audits & Ispezioni
• Assicurare la disponibilità di ispezione in ogni momento e mantenere un sistema di gestione della qualità robusto.
• Guida e supervisiona le ispezioni normative, le verifiche dei clienti e le valutazioni di qualità aziendale.
• Agire come rappresentante di qualità primaria durante le interazioni con le autorità di regolamentazione e i clienti chiave.
• Assicurare un'indagine tempestiva ed efficace, l'analisi delle cause radice e l'attuazione di azioni correttive e preventive (CAPA). Sistemi di qualità e miglioramento continuo
• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo in tutti i processi e sistemi di qualità.
• Promuovere l'uso di metodologie di qualità moderne e strumenti di qualità digitale, tra cui Six Sigma, principi Lean, FMEA, SPC e analisi avanzate.
• Assicurare una gestione efficace di deviazioni, controlli di cambiamento, reclami, CAPAs, valutazioni di rischio e recensioni di qualità del prodotto.
• Stabilire e monitorare indicatori di qualità significativi per guidare l'eccellenza operativa e le prestazioni aziendali. Gestione del rischio e decisione
• Applicare approcci basati sulla scienza e sul rischio alla supervisione della qualità e al processo decisionale.
• Anticipare e mitigare proattivamente i rischi di qualità e conformità associati alla crescita del sito, alle nuove tecnologie e ai programmi del cliente.
• Assicurare un'escalation efficace e una risoluzione di problemi di qualità critici, mentre bilanciare la sicurezza del paziente, la conformità e gli obiettivi aziendali. Cliente & Stakeholder Impegno
• Costruire partnership forti con i clienti, servendo come rappresentante di qualità chiave per le relazioni strategiche dei clienti.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con altri leader di qualità del sito e team di qualità globale per armonizzare standard, processi e best practice.
• Sostenere le attività di sviluppo aziendale, le visite dei clienti, le valutazioni di due diligence e le nuove introduzioni dei prodotti.
• Rappresentare il sito all'interno di reti di qualità globali e forum del settore. Leadership industriale e regolamentare
• Monitorare i requisiti normativi emergenti, le tendenze del settore e i progressi tecnologici che influiscono sulla produzione di prodotti farmaceutici.
• Tradurre gli sviluppi del settore in pratiche strategie di qualità e miglioramenti operativi.
• Campione di innovazione e modernizzazione iniziative che rafforzano la posizione competitiva del sito all'interno del mercato CDMO.
• Agire come leader visibile internamente ed esternamente, rappresentando Lonza a livello industriale, normativo e comunitario. Requisiti chiave e qualifiche
• Laurea magistrale in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Gestione della Qualità, Scienze della Vita, Ingegneria, o una disciplina relativa. Le qualifiche avanzate in qualità, affari normativi o leadership aziendale sono considerate vantaggiose.
• Diversi anni di esperienza progressiva di leadership all'interno di organizzazioni di qualità farmaceutica.
• Molti anni in un ruolo di leadership di qualità superiore con responsabilità diretta per le operazioni di qualità su scala del sito.
• Competenze dimostrate nella produzione di prodotti farmaceutici, biotecnologici o CDMO.
• Provato il record di controllo delle normative con successo da FDA, EMA, Swissmedic e altre autorità sanitarie globali.
• L'esperienza che supporta espansioni di siti su larga scala, la trasformazione organizzativa, o la crescita operativa significativa è altamente auspicabile.
• Forte comprensione di biologici, produzione sterile, elaborazione asettica e moderni sistemi di qualità farmaceutica. Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente. La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur cinq continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur exécutif, responsable du site qualité, Stein. Rôle But : Le responsable du site Qualité est un membre clé de l'équipe de direction du site et est chargé de diriger, de développer et d'améliorer continuellement toutes les activités liées à la qualité dans l'ensemble du site. À mesure que l'organisation étendra ses capacités de fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques (PD) et qu'elle évaluera ses activités, ce rôle assurera un leadership stratégique et opérationnel de qualité afin d'assurer les normes les plus élevées en matière de qualité des produits, de sécurité des patients, de conformité réglementaire et de rendement opérationnel. Le responsable du site de la qualité dirigera la culture de la qualité du site, renforcera les capacités organisationnelles et assurera l'harmonisation avec les stratégies de qualité mondiales tout en appuyant la croissance réussie d'une organisation de développement et de fabrication de classe mondiale. Le rôle jouera un rôle crucial dans la préparation du site en vue d'une expansion future, des inspections réglementaires, des vérifications des clients et une complexité accrue de la fabrication. Principales responsabilités : Leadership de qualité et gouvernance du site
• Servir de chef principal de la qualité du site et de conseiller de confiance auprès du chef de site et de l'équipe de direction.
• Définir et exécuter la stratégie de qualité du site en fonction des objectifs de qualité globaux et des priorités opérationnelles.
• Diriger toutes les fonctions de qualité, y compris l'assurance de la qualité, le contrôle de la qualité, la conformité, la validation et les systèmes de qualité.
• Favoriser une culture de qualité proactive qui favorise la responsabilisation, l'amélioration continue et la prise de décisions centrées sur le patient.
• Créer et développer une organisation de qualité hautement performante capable de soutenir la croissance importante du site et la complexité opérationnelle croissante. Leadership en matière de qualité des produits pharmaceutiques
• Diriger et renforcer toutes les activités de qualité liées à la fabrication, à l'emballage, aux essais, aux rejets et à la gestion du cycle de vie des produits pharmaceutiques.
• Assurer la conformité avec les exigences actuelles du GxP, la FDA, l'EMA, Swissmedic et les autres normes réglementaires mondiales applicables.
• Fournir des conseils d'experts sur les aspects qualitatifs du traitement aseptique, de la fabrication stérile, des produits biologiques et des technologies avancées des produits pharmaceutiques, selon le cas.
• Collaborez étroitement avec Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain et Technical Services afin d'assurer une surveillance de qualité robuste tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.
• Passez du temps sur l'atelier de Gemba comme entraîneur. Croissance organisationnelle et développement des capacités
• Développer l'organisation de qualité pour soutenir la croissance du site, qui passe d'environ 500 à 1 000 employés.
• Évaluer les capacités organisationnelles et cerner les lacunes en matière de compétences entre les fonctions de qualité.
• Mettre en oeuvre des programmes de perfectionnement des talents, de planification de la relève, d'encadrement et de formation pour renforcer les capacités de leadership futures.
• Attirer, retenir et développer des talents de qualité tout en favorisant une culture d'engagement, de collaboration et d'innovation.
• Travailler épaule à épaule avec la tête du site champion de culture de qualité. Conformité réglementaire, vérifications et inspections
• Assurer la préparation à l'inspection en tout temps et maintenir un solide système de gestion de la qualité.
• Diriger et superviser les inspections réglementaires, les vérifications des clients et les évaluations de la qualité de l'entreprise.
• Agir en tant que principal représentant de la qualité lors des interactions avec les autorités réglementaires et les principaux clients.
• Veiller à ce que les enquêtes, l'analyse des causes profondes et la mise en oeuvre des mesures correctives et préventives soient menées en temps opportun et efficacement. Systèmes de qualité et amélioration continue
• Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans tous les processus et systèmes de qualité.
• Promouvoir l'utilisation de méthodologies de qualité modernes et d'outils de qualité numérique, y compris Six Sigma, principes Lean, FMEA, SPC, et l'analyse avancée.
• Assurer une gestion efficace des écarts, des contrôles du changement, des plaintes, des APC, des évaluations des risques et des examens de la qualité des produits.
• Établir et surveiller des indicateurs de rendement de qualité significatifs pour stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle et le rendement opérationnel. Gestion des risques et prise de décisions
• Appliquer des approches fondées sur la science et le risque à la surveillance de la qualité et à la prise de décisions.
• Anticiper et atténuer proactivement les risques de qualité et de conformité associés à la croissance du site, aux nouvelles technologies et aux programmes à la clientèle.
• Assurer une escalade et une résolution efficaces des problèmes de qualité critiques tout en conciliant la sécurité des patients, la conformité et les objectifs opérationnels. Engagement des clients et des intervenants
• Établir des partenariats solides avec les clients, en servant de représentant de qualité clé pour les relations stratégiques avec les clients.
• Collaborer étroitement avec d'autres responsables de la qualité des sites et des équipes de la qualité mondiale pour harmoniser les normes, les processus et les pratiques exemplaires.
• Appuyer les activités de développement des entreprises, les visites des clients, les évaluations de diligence raisonnable et les introductions de nouveaux produits.
• Représenter le site dans les réseaux mondiaux de qualité et les forums industriels. Leadership de l'industrie et de la réglementation
• Surveiller les nouvelles exigences réglementaires, les tendances de l'industrie et les progrès technologiques qui influent sur la fabrication des produits pharmaceutiques.
• Traduire les développements de l'industrie en stratégies pratiques de qualité et en améliorations opérationnelles.
• Combattre les initiatives d'innovation et de modernisation qui renforcent la position concurrentielle du site sur le marché des CDMO.
• Agir en tant que leader visible à l'interne et à l'externe, représentant Lonza au niveau de l'industrie, de la réglementation et de la collectivité. Principales exigences et qualités
• Maîtrise en sciences pharmaceutiques, gestion de la qualité, sciences de la vie, génie ou discipline connexe. Les qualifications avancées en matière de qualité, de réglementation ou de leadership commercial sont considérées comme avantageuses.
• Plusieurs années d'expérience de leadership progressif au sein des organisations de qualité pharmaceutique.
• Plusieurs années dans un rôle de leadership de haute qualité avec responsabilité directe pour les opérations de qualité à l'échelle du site.
• Expertise démontrée dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques dans un environnement pharmaceutique, biotechnologiques ou CDMO.
• La FDA, l'EMA, Swissmedic et d'autres autorités sanitaires mondiales ont fait preuve de succès dans leurs inspections réglementaires.
• Il est hautement souhaitable d'acquérir de l'expérience pour appuyer l'expansion à grande échelle des sites, la transformation organisationnelle ou la croissance opérationnelle importante.
• Une bonne compréhension des produits biologiques, de la fabrication stérile, du traitement aseptique et des systèmes modernes de qualité pharmaceutique. Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique. Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

titleByLocale.it: (Junior) Controllo della qualità degli scienziati, materie prime 80-100% (f/m/d)

jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

We are looking for a committed person for the position of (Junior) Scientist (f/m/d) Quality Control, Raw Materials . In this role, you will be instrumental in ensuring the quality of raw materials. They support the development and validation of analytical methods and carry out comprehensive quality controls.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Perform quality controls by certificates on raw materials according to established SOPs and specifications

• Collaboration in troubleshooting activities

• Collaboration in the processing of deviations, OOS results and CAPAs

• Ensuring compliance with GMP and GLP guidelines as well as internal quality standards

• Active participation in the continuous improvement of processes and procedures in the team

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Biochemistry/ Biology/ Chemistry/ Pharmacy or a comparable scientific discipline

• Initial professional experience in the field of quality control, preferably in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry (for the junior position - a corresponding academic experience is also sufficient)

• Sound knowledge of common analytical methods (e.g. HPLC, GC, spectroscopy, ELISA, SDS-PAGE)

• Familiarity with GMP and GLP regulations is an advantage

• Fluent English is required, good German language skills are preferred

• Strong ability to work in a team, initiative and careful way of working

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de projet principal de l'IE&C TI/OT 80-100% (m/f/j)

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Engineering team in Visp as an EI&C MES Application Manager 80-100% (m/f/d) and drive the evolution of our MES landscape across its full lifecycle. In this role, you’ll shape digital manufacturing by leading MES projects, strengthening system standards, and ensuring GMP‑compliant, high‑impact system performance.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you’ll do:

• Execute and lead MES projects across all lifecycle phases, including requirement analysis, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

• Maintain, optimize, and further develop MES standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and alignment with site and global guidelines.

• Ensure reliable operation, enhancement, and updating of MES systems, recognizing their direct impact on production processes and GMP‑compliant documentation.

• Collaborate closely with Operations, QA, Automation, and IT/OT teams to ensure seamless system integration and high system availability.

• Analyze and improve MES‑related workflows, identifying opportunities for digitalization, efficiency gains, and data integrity improvements.

• Coordinate and manage external partners and vendors involved in MES or OT‑related project and support activities.

• Ensure GMP‑compliant execution of all MES and OT activities, including documentation, change control, and validation readiness.

What we are looking for:

• Completed university degree in Computer Science, Industrial IT/OT, Automation Engineering, or a related field (Bachelor level or higher).

• Significant professional experience in IT/OT, MES, or automation‑related engineering roles within a regulated environment.

• Solid understanding of GMP requirements and experience working with validated production or automation systems.

• Responsibility for the MES lifecycle, including system operation, enhancements, release management, and interface coordination.

• Strong knowledge of OT networks, virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware), system architectures, and basic cybersecurity principles.

• Fluent German or English (minimum B2 level) for effective collaboration with local and global stakeholders.

• Structured, independent working style with strong communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Willingness to participate in on‑call duty (Pikettdienst) 2-3 times per year.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our site in Visp we are currently looking for a Senior Quality Excellence Manager (m/f/d), who will become part of our Quality Excellence team. In this role, you will drive operational excellence at its best and contribute as a strong influential LEAN specialist within a matrix organization to support our Quality organization on its way to best in class performance.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Drive process standardization and efficiency in line with Lonza’s LBMS standards

• Support the implementation of a Lean Batch Release program on site

• Establish Quality Excellence CoE and PMO structures, supporting the standardization, simplification and digitalization of our key quality processes

• Facilitate to embed a LEAN culture of continuous improvement and ideation within Quality

• Monitor and enable reporting of Quality performance KPIs for our site in Visp and initiate necessary activities to enable target achievement by the departments in scope

• Support multi-disciplinary project teams and hold team members accountable to achieve the project goals within given timelines

• Share best practice within the Visp Site as well as with the wider Lonza Pharma network

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in a scientific area OR an absolved apprenticeship in a pharmaceutical environment (e.g. Lab Technician, CPT, etc)

• Profound experience in a GMP regulated environment; preferably within QA/QC

• Experience with Lean / Six Sigma, within a Quality related environment

• Certified Green Belt or higher is required

• PowerBI and/or Minitab knowledge would be an advantage

• Fluent German (written and verbal) and good English language skills are required

• Strong ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different functions

jobs.title: Operations Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Operations Support: Operations Support Specialist, Large Scale Mammalian

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula for how we do it. Our greatest scientific solutions are dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for Operations Support and Manufacturing Specialists for our 6x20K Large Scale Mammalian Facility. In this role, you will be responsible for performing operational activities within the Operations Support Team in partnership with Buffer Media Supply, USP and DSP.

What you’ll do:

• Assignments within the Operations Support team focused on receipt and management of raw materials, single use materials, dispensing of small volume and large-scale medias and buffers.

• Processing of parts in washers and autoclaves

• Transport and storage of materials within temperature-controlled requirements

• Recognition, interpretation, and elimination of deviations

• Execution of tasks in compliance with safety regulations and cGMP quality requirements.

• Execution of production steps including interaction with HMIs and automated systems

• Support on-going training to develop your technical skills in a fast paced, large scale mammalian facility (6 x 20K Bioreactors)

What we’re looking for:

• Fluent English with German language skills advantageous

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or vocational training preferred

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician in a GMP environment is a plus

• Safety mindset; forklift and/or electric pallet truck training will be required

• Continuous improvement mindset with attention to detail and support of 6S standards

• Willingness to work in shifts (e.g. 2 or 3-shift pattern) with flexible work scheduling

• Day shift schedule to start during training period and establishment of the Operations Support Department.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

• Riconoscimento, interpretazione e eliminazione delle deviazioni
• Esecuzione dei compiti in conformità alle normative di sicurezza e ai requisiti di qualità cGMP.
• Esecuzione delle fasi di produzione, compresa l'interazione con HMI e sistemi automatizzati
• Supporto formazione in corso per sviluppare le tue competenze tecniche in una struttura mammifera veloce e su larga scala (6 x 20K Bioreattori) Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Inglese fluente con competenze di lingua tedesca vantaggioso
• Preferito l'istruzione chimica / biofarmaceutica o la formazione professionale
• Esperienza professionale nella produzione farmaceutica come operatore / tecnico di produzione in un ambiente GMP è un plus
• Attenzione di sicurezza; carrello elevatore e/o addestramento del carrello elettrico
• Mindset di miglioramento continuo con attenzione ai dettagli e supporto agli standard 6S
• Volontà di lavoro a turni (ad esempio 2 o 3 turni) con programmazione flessibile del lavoro
• Programma di turni di giorno per iniziare durante il periodo di formazione e l'istituzione del Dipartimento di Supporto Operazioni. Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente. La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa. Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, status veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Unsere größten wissenschaftlichen Lösungen sind engagierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. • Unterstützen Sie laufende Schulungen, um Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten in einer schnelllebigen, großen Säugetieranlage (6 x 20K Bioreaktoren) zu entwickeln Was wir suchen:
• Fließendes Englisch mit deutschen Sprachkenntnissen vorteilhaft
• Abgeschlossene chemische/biopharmazeutische Aus- oder Weiterbildung bevorzugt

Im Gegenzug bieten wir Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem signifikanten Unterschied einhergeht. • Achevé l'enseignement chimique / biopharmaceutique ou la formation professionnelle préféré

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Drive value across indirect procurement categories by sourcing new suppliers, leading tenders, and negotiating impactful contracts that support seamless site operations.
Collaborate with regional and global procurement teams while managing CHF 35–60M spend, building strong supplier partnerships, and ensuring business continuity by aligning procurement strategies with evolving site needs. Check out your Career at Lonza!

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Partner with regional procurement and category management teams to implement sourcing strategies, deliver continuous improvement, and generate measurable value across indirect spend.

• Lead and support sourcing initiatives—tendering, negotiation, and contracting—while driving the adoption of innovative tools such as e-auctions and online catalogs.

• Collaborate with site stakeholders to ensure business continuity, align procurement with current and future needs, and provide accurate spend and savings forecasts.

• Manage supplier relationships end-to-end, fostering strong partnerships, monitoring performance, and driving innovation while ensuring compliance and mitigating supply risks.

• Optimize procurement efficiency by standardizing specifications, sharing best practices across sites, and identifying savings opportunities, risks, and synergies within a CHF 35–60M spend portfolio.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience in procurement with a strong focus on strategic sourcing, negotiation, and value creation beyond transactional tasks

• Demonstrated ability to think strategically, influencing and partnering with stakeholders across functions to drive impactful procurement outcomes

• Industry experience in pharma preferred with GMP knowledge considered a strong advantage

• Strong communication skills with fluency in English; German is a plus

• Familiarity with procurement tools and analytics (e.g., SAP Ariba, Power BI) and experience implementing category strategies is highly desirable

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Ottimizzare l'efficienza degli appalti standardizzando le specifiche, la condivisione delle migliori pratiche tra i siti, l'individuazione delle opportunità di risparmio, dei rischi e delle sinergie all'interno di un portafoglio di spesa di CHF 35–60M. Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Esperienza comprovata nell'approvvigionamento con una forte attenzione al sourcing strategico, alla negoziazione e alla creazione di valore oltre i compiti transazionali
• Dimostrata capacità di pensare strategicamente, influenzando e collaborando con le parti interessate attraverso le funzioni per guidare risultati di approvvigionamento
• Esperienza nel settore farmaceutico preferita con la conoscenza GMP considerato un forte vantaggio
• Forte capacità di comunicazione con fluenza in inglese; il tedesco è un plus
• La familiarità con gli strumenti di approvvigionamento e l'analisi (ad esempio, SAP Ariba, Power BI) e l'esperienza che implementa le strategie di categoria è altamente auspicabile Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Lonza als führender Auftragshersteller von Antikörper Wirkstoff Konjugate (ADCs) besitzt langjährige Erfahrungen am Standort Visp für die klinischen und kommerzielle Produktion dieser aufstrebenden Klasse von Medikamenten. Die Erforschung und Herstellung von ADCs und anderen Biokonjugaten befinden sich weltweit in einer starken Wachstumsphase und somit auch in unserem Unternehmen, weshalb wir nach einen neuen und engagierten Laboratory Technician suchen, um unser Team Analytische Entwicklung  am Standort Visp zu verstärken.

Als Mitglied unserer Abteilung bist Du an der Entwicklung, Optimierung und Validierung von analytischen Methoden für die prozessbegleitende Analytik und Freigabe von Biokonjugaten beteiligt. Du arbeitest nach ISO- und GMP Qualitätsrichtlinien, planst und bearbeitest eigenverantwortlich die dir zugeteilten Analysenaufträge und erstellst die dazugehörige Dokumentation.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Entwicklung, Optimierung und Validierung von analytischen Methoden wie zum Beispiel RP-, SE- und IEX-HPLC, icIEF, CE-SDS, UV/VIS-Spektroskopie und ELISA

• Eigenständige Durchführung der geplanten Laborarbeiten gemäss dem definierten Zeitplan; angemessene Dokumentation der Rohdaten und Erstellen von Studienprotokollen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Berichten

• Gewährleisten eines effizienten Laborbetriebs durch das Einhalten der Hygiene Vorschriften, Wartung und Unterhalt der Laborgeräte, Überwachung des Inventars und das rechtzeitige Beschaffung der Roh- und Verbrauchsmaterialien

• Sicherstellen, dass die eigene Ausbildung auf dem neuesten Stand ist, einweisen und trainieren von Mitarbeitern auf spezifischen Instrumenten und Analysetechniken, flexibel und enthusiastisch um auch andere Aktivitäten innerhalb der Abteilung zu unterstützen

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Als Bioprocess Engineer übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Planung, Durchführung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer GMP-Bioprozesse. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, MSAT, Quality und Engineering stellen Sie eine zuverlässige, effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Produktion sicher und tragen damit direkt zur Herstellung lebensverändernder Therapien für Patienten weltweit bei.

Diese Position ist eine vollständig standortgebundene Rolle. Die enge persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort ermöglicht eine direkte Abstimmung in Echtzeit und unterstützt die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was auf Sie wartet

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

• Die Möglichkeit, komplexe GMP-Bioprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und zu optimieren.

• Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Vielfältige Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

• Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie hier: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Ihre Aufgaben

• Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von GMP-Produktionskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Operations.

• Betriebstechnische und organisatorische Betreuung der GMP-Produktion sowie Schulung und Unterstützung des Produktionspersonals.

• Erstellung, Optimierung und Kontrolle von GMP-relevanten Produktionsdokumenten (z. B. EBRs, SOPs und Arbeitsanweisungen).

• Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen und termingerechten Bearbeitung von Deviations (DRs), Change Requests (CRs) und CAPAs nach dem First-Time-Right-Prinzip.

• Überwachung, Trending und Reporting operativer Prozesskennzahlen sowie Identifikation und Implementierung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen mittels Lean, Six Sigma, 6S und Kaizen.

• Sicherstellung eines technisch einwandfreien, sauberen und qualifizierten Zustands der Produktionsanlagen und -bereiche sowie Durchführung von Troubleshooting und Pikettdienst.

• Durchführung und Optimierung von Reinigungsprozessen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Verantwortlichen aus Operations und MSAT sowie Durchführung von Risikoanalysen in den Bereichen SHE, Operations, Environmental Monitoring und Reinigung.

Was wir suchen

• Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Biotechnologie, Bioprozesstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen, Life Sciences oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung.

• Erfahrung in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld der Biotechnologie-, Pharma- oder Life-Science-Industrie.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse biotechnologischer Herstellprozesse sowie GMP-Anforderungen und Dokumentationsstandards.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls und Risikobewertungen.

• Erfahrung mit Operational Excellence, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma oder vergleichbaren kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden von Vorteil.

In this varied function, you will take on challenging work in the field of pipe construction as well as the reactive, proactive and preventive maintenance of our production facilities. Your profile:

jobs.title: Senior Bioprocess Engineer (m/w/d) 80%-100%
jobs.description:
Senior Bioprocess Engineer (m/w/d) 80%-100%

Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Als Senior Bioprocess Engineer – Senior Expert Biotechnologist Manufacturing übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der erfolgreichen Durchführung von GMP-Produktionskampagnen und treiben die technische Weiterentwicklung von biotechnologischen Herstellprozessen voran. Sie arbeiten eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, fördern kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und unterstützen die fachliche Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden in einem dynamischen Produktionsumfeld.

Diese Position ist eine vollständig standortgebundene Rolle. Die enge persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort ermöglicht eine direkte Abstimmung in Echtzeit und unterstützt die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was auf Sie wartet

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

• Eine Expertenrolle mit hoher technischer Verantwortung und Sichtbarkeit innerhalb der Organisation.

• Die Möglichkeit, Produktionsprozesse und technische Strategien aktiv mitzugestalten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit multidisziplinären Teams aus Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality und Engineering.

• Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie hier: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Ihre Aufgaben

• Verantwortung für die GMP-konforme Durchführung und technische Betreuung von Produktionskampagnen im Upstream- und Downstream-Bereich.

• Erstellung, Review und Umsetzung von Risikoanalysen sowie Nachverfolgung der daraus resultierenden Maßnahmen.

• Sicherstellung der erfolgreichen Chargenausführung einschließlich Datenanalyse, Bewertung von Testergebnissen, Fehlerbehebung und Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lösungen.

• Sicherstellung einer vollständigen und qualitativ hochwertigen GMP-Dokumentation sowie Dokumentation von Prozesswissen.

• Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten für Prozesse, Anlagen und Abläufe in enger Zusammenarbeit mit MSAT und weiteren Stakeholdern.

• Verantwortung für produktspezifische Kampagnenschulungen sowie Unterstützung der bereichsübergreifenden Ausbildung von Mitarbeitenden.

• Förderung der fachlichen Weiterentwicklung innerhalb des Teams durch Coaching, Workshops, Präsentationen sowie Unterstützung bei Audits und Inspektionen.

Was wir suchen

• Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Biotechnologie, Bioinformatik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachgebiet.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder biotechnologischen Produktion mit fundiertem GMP-Verständnis.

• Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Optimierung biotechnologischer Produktionsprozesse, idealerweise in USP- und/oder DSP-Umgebungen.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Abweichungen, Risikoanalysen, Prozessverbesserungen und GMP-Dokumentation.

• Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

• Nachweisbare funktionsübergreifende Führungsqualitäten sowie Potenzial zur Übernahme direkter Führungsverantwortung.

• Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Schulungsfähigkeiten.
